topic: 资源分配与阶段检查 · Independent new scenario: a review of an education intervention
grammarFocus: 条件句；数量词；段落间的指代与衔接。 Teach the new rule in Chinese, then provide at least 8 distinct grammar questions in new sentences. Distinguish a newly taught form from revision. All main reading/listening question prompts and options must be English, with short A0/A1 English prompts. Chinese explanations are allowed. Preserve a coherent new scenario; do not rename an earlier text, reuse its facts or reveal answers in question stems.
sourcePolicy: Project-original scenario; simulated figures and people; no copied official test, textbook, GitHub PDF or third-party audio.
title: A Review of the 'Read to Succeed' Intervention
instructions: 这是一份模拟的英语听力与阅读练习材料，主题为“资源分配与阶段检查”，语法重点为条件句、数量词以及段落间的指代与衔接。请先听或读一遍录音稿，然后完成10道题目。题目类型包括单选、填空和判断正误/未提及。所有题目和选项均为英文，解释为中文。请仔细阅读题目要求，答案必须基于原文。本材料不是官方雅思考试，也不代表任何分数等级。
transcript:
Mia: Hi, Ben. Thanks for coming to the review meeting. Let's look at the 'Read to Succeed' program. It ran for six months in three primary schools.
Ben: Sure. I have the final report here. Overall, the results are positive, but there are some issues with resources.
Mia: Right. Let's start with the numbers. How many students took part?
Ben: We had 240 students in total. 120 in the experimental group and 120 in the control group. The experimental group received 30 minutes of extra reading practice every day.
Mia: And what about the teachers? Did they get any training?
Ben: Yes, but only 15 teachers were trained, and that was just for two days. Some teachers said they needed more support.
Mia: I see. So, what were the main findings?
Ben: Well, the experimental group improved their reading scores by 20 percent on average, while the control group improved by only 5 percent. That's a significant difference.
Mia: That's great. But did all students benefit equally?
Ben: Not exactly. Students who already had good reading skills improved less. The biggest gains were among students who started with lower scores.
Mia: Interesting. Now, about resources. Did you have enough books?
Ben: No, we didn't. We only had 200 books for 240 students. So some students had to share. Also, the books were not very interesting for older students.
Mia: That's a problem. What about the time? Was 30 minutes enough?
Ben: Most teachers said 30 minutes was too short. They wanted 45 minutes. But the school day is already full.
Mia: So, if we run the program again, what should we change?
Ben: If we have more funding, we should buy more books and train more teachers. Also, we could make the reading time longer, but only if we can find extra time in the timetable.
Mia: OK. And how about the assessment? Did you use the same test before and after?
Ben: Yes, we used the same reading test. But some teachers said the test was too easy for the older students.
Mia: I see. So, overall, would you recommend continuing the program?
Ben: Yes, definitely. But we need to fix the resource problems first. If we don't, the results might not be as good next time.
Mia: Agreed. Let's write a summary report and suggest some changes. Thanks, Ben.
Ben: You're welcome.

questions.prompt: How many students participated in the program?
questions.explanation: 原文中Ben说“We had 240 students in total.”，因此总人数是240。
Ben提到“only 15 teachers were trained”，所以接受培训的教师是15名。

questions.prompt: What was the average improvement of the experimental group?
questions.explanation: Ben说实验组平均提高了20%：“the experimental group improved their reading scores by 20 percent on average”。
questions.evidence: the experimental group improved their reading scores by 20 percent on average

questions.prompt: Which students made the biggest gains?
questions.explanation: Ben指出进步最大的是起点分数较低的学生：“The biggest gains were among students who started with lower scores.”
questions.evidence: The biggest gains were among students who started with lower scores.

questions.prompt: How many books were available for the students? (Write a number.)
questions.explanation: Ben说“We only had 200 books for 240 students.”，因此书的数量是200。
questions.evidence: We only had 200 books for 240 students.

questions.prompt: How many minutes did most teachers want for reading time? (Write a number.)
questions.explanation: Ben提到大多数老师希望有45分钟：“They wanted 45 minutes.”

questions.prompt: What did some teachers say about the test?
options: It was too easy for older students.
It was too difficult for younger students.
It was not related to the program.
answers: It was too easy for older students.
questions.explanation: Ben说有些老师认为测试对年龄较大的学生来说太简单了：“some teachers said the test was too easy for the older students.”
questions.evidence: some teachers said the test was too easy for the older students.

questions.prompt: What does Ben recommend if they have more funding?
options: Buy more books and train more teachers.
answers: Buy more books and train more teachers.
questions.explanation: Ben建议如果有更多资金，应该买更多书并培训更多教师：“If we have more funding, we should buy more books and train more teachers.”
questions.evidence: If we have more funding, we should buy more books and train more teachers.

questions.prompt: True or false: The control group improved by 20 percent.
questions.explanation: 原文说控制组只提高了5%：“the control group improved by only 5 percent”，因此该陈述错误。
questions.evidence: the control group improved by only 5 percent

questions.prompt: True or false: The program will definitely continue next year.
questions.explanation: 原文中Ben建议继续该项目，但并未明确说明明年一定会继续。因此该信息未提及。
questions.evidence: Yes, definitely. But we need to fix the resource problems first.

grammar.title: 条件句、数量词与指代衔接
grammar.explanation: 条件句用来表达“如果……就……”：if 从句用一般现在时，主句用 will/can/must 等。数量词如 many, much, a few, a little 修饰名词。段落间的指代与衔接通过代词（it, they, this, these）和连接词（however, therefore, also）使文章连贯。
grammar.example: If we have more funding, we should buy more books and train more teachers.

questions.prompt: If it rains tomorrow, we ______ the picnic.
questions.explanation: 条件句中主句用将来时，if从句用一般现在时。
questions.evidence: If we have more funding, we should buy more books and train more teachers.

questions.prompt: She will pass the exam if she ______ hard.
questions.explanation: if从句用一般现在时表示将来条件。
questions.evidence: If we have more funding, we should buy more books and train more teachers.

questions.prompt: There are ______ books on the shelf, but only ______ time to read them.
questions.explanation: books是可数名词复数用many；time是不可数名词用a little。
questions.evidence: We only had 200 books for 240 students.

questions.prompt: We don't have ______ information about the new program.
questions.explanation: information是不可数名词，否定句中用much。
questions.evidence: We only had 200 books for 240 students.

questions.prompt: The students shared the books. ______ was not easy for them.
questions.explanation: 指代前面整个句子“分享书籍”这件事，用it。
questions.evidence: So some students had to share.

questions.prompt: The teachers wanted more training. ______, the school had no extra money.
questions.evidence: Some teachers said they needed more support.

questions.prompt: If the program ______ more funding, it would help more students.
questions.explanation: 虚拟条件句表示与现在事实相反，if从句用过去式。
questions.evidence: If we have more funding, we should buy more books and train more teachers.

questions.prompt: There ______ a few students who need extra help.
questions.explanation: a few students是复数，be动词用are。
questions.evidence: The biggest gains were among students who started with lower scores.
